reviews.review_description: It took me 3 to 5 weeks of organising quotes from at least 6 companies to really get my head around panels, inverters and the hundreds of models, brands and bucket loads of information out there to get through. The first 3 were face to face and by that stage I knew what system I required and then organised quotes via email. Thankfully this research and the headaches paid off as I realised I did not need to pay top dollar for good quality panels and inverter etc. With Finns website/service this process was made much easier and I was eventually confident to make an informed decision. In the end I went with a local company who provided top quality products and service with warranties for much cheaper than some of the better known groups. I am glad I took my time as there were two solar groups who I was considering which if I decided to go with would have cost me $2000+ more than what I eventually paid. Very happy with my choice and very appreciative of Finns service.
